name: Centaureissi
quote: A warmth underneath the icy exterior.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Guten Morgen, Master. Any plans for today?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: No matter how busy work becomes, please don't forget to occasionally take a break.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: It's dinner time. Please enjoy your meal.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: A good night's sleep is necessary to ensure productivity. Master, you seem to still have work to do?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Housework can get troublesome sometimes, but it's not a big deal for me.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Master, if you have any problems or requests, please do not hesitate to let me know. I will do my best.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Master, are you taking a break? I will not disturb you then.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: The dormitory needs to be cleaned regularly, but I may not be able to finish the job on time by myself. Master, could you please lend me a hand?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hehe...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: What can I help you with?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Please don't move unnecessarily.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Leave it to me!

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Centaureissi. I am ready to respond to your various work orders, Master.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: My work performance has been further improved.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I will eliminate any threats in your way to the best of my ability, no matter how difficult the situation can be.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: It is a great honor for me to serve you, Master. I will continue to do my best in meeting your needs.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Please leave it to me.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Elimination begins.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Be gone, you filth!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: This is a part of my duty as a maid.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Cleaning complete.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: How unsightly...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: I have managed to fulfil all my responsibilities perfectly because of you. Without your support and encouragement, I wouldn't have gotten this far. Today, our bond has deepened again. In our days to come, please allow me to stay by your side as your maid.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Master. It's likely going to be a busy day for me, but I will be sure to take some time to be with you. Master, would you like something to eat?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Chocolate is a symbol of sweetness to many, but it's still bad for your teeth to eat too much of it. I am aware of that, still I figured I should give you chocolate on this day to express my gratitude. I hope it is to your liking.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: As a maid, I must stay professional even when it's a holiday. Since it is Tanabata today, I have prepared a meal for you and everyone else. I hope you will enjoy it.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: A freshly baked pumpkin pie... It is the perfect Halloween dessert, don't you think? I've added some heavy cream to improve the smooth texture.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: A maid's burden is great, but I'm glad I had everyone to help me today, it really took a load off my shoulders. Master, Merry Christmas!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
Today is your important day, Master.
As your maid, I have been preparing for this day in advance. I promise to do my best to meet your every request today. As long as those requests are not too outlandish, that is...

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Sometimes I need a break too... Even the best Dolls can tire.
Master, if you're not in a hurry, may I rest for a while? It won't take long.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
I always find strange objects during my routine cleaning of the dormitory.
Broken hairpins, envelopes covered in doodles, and tattered stuffed animals.
Those and... sometimes I find insects too... Master, are you feeling all right? Shall we change the topic?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
When I have time, I enjoy gardening in the dormitory.
Growing plants is a delicate task that takes perseverance to complete. A small mistake gone unnoticed could ruin everything later.
By the way, have you ever tried to grow anything, master? Yes, a cactus counts too.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
You seem to be tired, master. Did you have too much work to deal with today?
I should get you something invigorating then. The raspberry chocolate cake I baked last night should still be in the fridge. It's not fresh anymore, but that should not impact its qualities. Besides, there is a unique texture to a chilled cake.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Obeying master's orders is my top priority as a maid.
That being said, exchanging opinions from time to time is important too.
Blind obedience simply isn't feasible in this day and age... Master, if you have any concerns you would like to discuss, please feel free to talk to me.

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehe

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Hm?

career:
The Butler-36 is a Doll model developed by UAS with support from Svarog Heavy Industries. It is a high-end model that can perform both housekeeping and bodyguard services.

Compared to the Butler-35 series, Butler-36 abandons the previous series' preconfigured personality module, instead opting for a basic emotional system that slowly develops after the Doll is awakened. This allows the Doll to be compatible with Svarog Heavy Industries' combat modules. As soon as this model was released, it flew off the shelves, becoming a particular favorite of businesspeople tired of constantly travelling with an entourage in tow.

In light of the Butler-36s special characteristics, 42Lab added them to the roster for Project Neural Cloud. As a partner to 42Lab's, UAS provided them with a Butler-36 who had returned to them—Centaureissi.
infoStories:
In order to be compatible with the combat modules developed by Svarog Heavy Industries, the Butler-36 had to abandon certain features that would not affect their general functionality. Specifically, the Butler-36 lacked the rich personality module that other Dolls possess, instead needing to learn from the outside world after awakening.

Of course, this point was dolled up in UAS's marketing campaign, and this shortcoming became a selling point: "The newest member of your family: grow together, hand-in-hand."

The couple that purchased Centaureissi was a very special pair, as they were tied to the military. They hoped to find a companion for their daughter who was studying at a military academy.

As a military family, they didn't much care for the overly enthusiastic Dolls on the market. Centaureissi was a much better fit for their family.

While in service to her employer, Centaureissi's behavior steadily became more militaristic. Capable and decisive, like her employer's daughter, she rejected the unnecessarily elaborate and embellished. The two became as close as sisters, sharing everything with each other.

Vayne taught Centaureissi many things about the world of humans and introduced her to her friends. People from the military academy tended to be straightforward, and Centaureissi soon became a member of their small group. No one cared much that she was a Doll, and actually were quite envious of her ability to learn cutting-edge martial skills through data transfer alone.

In her free time, Vayne would bring some friends over to spar with Centaureissi. With Centaureissi's help, they all scored full marks on their combat exam. After the results came out, they hosted a thank you party for Centaureissi and at the banquet, with everyone gathered around her, Centaureissi displayed her first smile since she was awakened.

Just as Centaureissi's personality module was maturing and she was learning to appreciate her surroundings, life threw its first curveball. Due to the escalation in hostilities, her employer and his wife were both called to support the war effort. The two met privately with Centaureissi before leaving. They did not know when they would return, but they warmly told her that she had become part of the family and that they were entrusting Vayne to her care.

This was the first time that Centaureissi felt that very human feeling of "parting" and the weight of taking on a heavy responsibility.

After that, Centaureissi focused on improving her housekeeping abilities. She studied recipes and tried to better understand human amusements so that she could always be a soothing presence in Vayne's life.

As life seemed to be returning to normal, Vayne suddenly handed her a contract and a letter, boarded a school military vehicle, and left the city without looking back.

"This is a receiving contract with Universal Anything Service. Mother and father left me a sum of money, which I've used to purchase long-term maintenance services for you. After you return, ownership will remain in my name, but you don't need to continue to work. You are free to pursue what you want to do.
I have enlisted and am going to go searching for mother and father. Do not follow me, Reissi. Don't come to the battlefield. This is my last command to you as your Master. I'm sorry that I was unable to say this to you face-to-face. I didn't dare... I'm sorry.
Please take care of yourself.
Your little sis, always and forever, Vayne."
—Universal Anything Services, Service Doll Administrative Department, Receiving Process File: Centaureissi

Centaureissi joined Project Neural Cloud by chance. Although she gained her freedom when she returned to UAS, losing her employer led to a loss of self. Besides work and searching for Vayne's family, her fundamental cognition was not presently sufficient to conceive of what she might "want to do". The former however, was no longer necessary, and the latter not permitted. This left her disconcerted for a long period, the details of which remain unclear.

As luck would have it, UAS was recruiting Butler-36 Dolls at 42Lab's request. After receiving advice of other Dolls, Centaureissi signed up, hoping to change her aimless existence. At least she could do some work there while figuring out what it is that she really wanted to do.
oathDesc: Nobody else in all the world is worth trusting unconditionally.

projections.name: Chief Servant
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"The whole day's plans will be disrupted if you do not get up on time. Please get up and get ready for breakfast immediately."

"The whole day's plans will be disrupted if you do not get up on time. Please get up and get ready for breakfast immediately."

projections.name: Sweet Scent
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"A certain smell can awaken the corresponding memories. The mere thought of a significant person brings a sweet smile to her face."

skinList.name: First Glimpse of Sky
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection—"Could I trouble you to take a step back, Master? This distance is not entirely proper, and it also prevents me from accurately recording your facial data..."

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware of drowning in a fool's game.
"If all this rubbish isn't cleaned up, the day's plans will be thrown into chaos. Please let me handle everything, Master."

skinList.name: Dreamsoothing Lilac-Bird
skinList.desc:
"Splendid Evening" Series — To celebrate an incoming special day, the Doll in question prepared a truly dazzling outfit, giving this wondrous realm a unique hue of its very own.
Velvety wings push aside the steely cold bars, coiling around mauve-shaded clouds, ever-so-carefully caressing this fatigued dreamscape.
"The gala has long been over. Sleep, then. Cast away what binds you, and soar beyond that horizon."

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Thank you for taking care of me all this while, Master... I'm delighted by everything you've done for me today."

skinList.name: Nature's Whisper
skinList.desc:
Iridescent Musicale — Riding a comet, coming right at you! This dazzling idol gala is a stage show that draws the cheers of countless audience members.
"Now who is this clear, pure song meant for? Allow me to help soothe your unsettled emotions—"
